verdict.rationale: Linear's developer docs describe webhooks that send HTTP push notifications whenever data is created, updated or removed. They also show programmatic subscription via the webhookCreate GraphQL mutation, scoped to a team or all public teams, which suits an AI-native user wiring up event-driven automation. Missing for 10: a documented event/resource-type catalog and payload schema, signature verification and retry/delivery-guarantee details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
